official_h01.synapse_version_note: Use 20210729 (final ~150.5M synapses matching paper Table S14), NOT 20210601 raw detections
official_h01.cave_note: Newer CAVE materializations exist (navis/caveclient) but require Google auth; this build uses only public HTTPS GCS + derived HF edge list.

urls_actually_used: https://storage.googleapis.com/h01-release/data/20210601/c3/tables/segments/counts000000000000.csv.gz (schema probe only; not used in module)

derived_edge_list.claim: Built from all 166 Avro shards of gs://h01-release/data/20210729/c3/synapses/exported/, min_confidence=0.50, soma-resident neurons only
derived_edge_list.verification: 16010/16087 HF segment_ids match official somas.csv c3_rep_manual; soma0 c3_rep_manual present
derived_edge_list.why_not_stream_all_avro: 166 shards x ~198MB Avro ≈ 33GB; JSON twins ≈ 126GB. Disk-safe path: use condensed local-connectome edge list already filtered to soma neurons.

module_stats.weight_rule: synapse_count * pre_sign; pre_sign from cell type (INTERNEURON=-1; PYRAMIDAL/SPINY_*=+1)

selection.note: Stratified so L4/L5 remain usable for layered fly bridge (densest-only cut starved L4).

reliability_vs_microns.mouse_microns_module: 1871 proofread roots (axon+dendrite proofread status), Zenodo condensed connectome v1412
reliability_vs_microns.human_h01_module: 2087 auto-segmented soma-linked cortical neurons; only 8 overlap the public 104 proofread set
reliability_vs_microns.verdict: Far less reliable than MICrONS proofread subset. H01 public proofread set is ~104 cells (too small for 1-3k module). Connectivity is ML-predicted synapses on conservative c3 agglomeration; merge/split errors remain.
reliability_vs_microns.slab_caveat: H01 is ~170µm thick; most dendrites leave the volume — degrees are lower bounds (paper).

feasibility.status: FEASIBLE for data prep / smoke tests; NOT equivalent reliability to mouse hybrid
blocking_for_news_claims: Almost no proofread neurons in the 2k module (8/2087)
Incomplete arbors due to thin slab
Full raw Avro rebuild is 33GB — optional later if disk allows
feasibility.ready_for_code_path: human_module.npz matches mouse_module.npz schema (W_*, root_id, sign, layer, cell_type)
